poll_interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often to check the charge level and regenerate the icon.

full_at.label: Full at (%)
full_at.description: Charge level this battery treats as full, for machines with a firmware charge limit. Colors are graded against this instead of 100%; the displayed percentage stays the real one. 0 detects it automatically.

low_threshold.label: Low threshold (%)
low_threshold.description: Charge percentage at or below which the low-battery color is used.

medium_threshold.label: Medium threshold (%)
medium_threshold.description: Charge percentage at or below which the medium-battery color is used.

low_color.label: Low color
low_color.description: Icon color when charge is at or below the low threshold.

medium_color.label: Medium color
medium_color.description: Icon color when charge is between the low and medium thresholds.

high_color.label: High color
high_color.description: Icon color when charge is above the medium threshold.

charging_color.label: Charging color
charging_color.description: Icon color while the battery is charging or full, regardless of level.

charging_bolt_color.label: Charging bolt color
charging_bolt_color.description: Fill color of the charging bolt.

power_saver_plus_color.label: Battery Saver plus color
power_saver_plus_color.description: Color of the “+” drawn beside the battery while Battery Saver is active.

text_color.label: Text color
text_color.description: Color of the percentage number baked into the icon.

empty_color.label: Empty color
empty_color.description: Fill color for the unfilled portion of the gauge.

charging_sound_enabled.label: Play sound on plug/unplug
charging_sound_enabled.description: Plays a short sound the moment the charger connects, and a different one when it's disconnected. Off by default.

icon_width.label: Icon width
icon_width.description: Bar display width of the rendered icon, in pixels.

icon_height.label: Icon height
icon_height.description: Bar display height of the rendered icon, in pixels.
